title: racosperma storyi

It belongs to the family Desfontainiaceae and is known for its medicinal properties and ornamental value. The health benefits of Racosperma storyi include its potential to lower blood pressure and cholesterol levels, while its therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties.
